selection_note: Practical Sentinel-2 human triage pilot. Automated flags are triage; human appearance observations are not certified ground truth. Formal accuracy calibration is not a prerequisite for this bounded review. Execute with explicit --sensors optical after sensor-selection integration.

genoa-morandi-east-demolition.label: Documented civilian viaduct demolition; unreviewed optical surface-change candidate
genoa-morandi-east-demolition.event_time_uncertainty: City account reports 09:37 local (CEST, UTC+2), represented to minute precision; source acquisition starts provide timing context.
genoa-morandi-east-demolition.selection_basis: 500 m square centred on an analyst-selected point in the eastern demolition area, fixed using the official evacuation map and current street geometry before detector output. Target [2019-06-28,2019-07-05) begins on the documented demolition day; unchanged rolling baseline [2019-05-31,2019-06-28) includes preparation and nearby works. The catalog contains a July 1 target and six earlier acquisition days. The contextual land AOI is not a surveyed pier footprint. No date, AOI or threshold is selected from detector output.

references.supports: City account dated June 28, 2019 reports demolition of the eastern remains at 09:37 local. Reconstruction had already begun, so the baseline includes works.
City event recap identifies the two remaining eastern piers 10 and 11, demolished June 28, 2019.

Official June 26 evacuation map locates the eastern works around Via Walter Fillak, Via Porro and the railway yard, east of the Polcevera. Contextual locator; not a georeferenced demolition footprint.
Current Via Walter Fillak street geometry cross-checks the analyst-selected location. Modern geometry does not establish 2019 surfaces.
